edges: Harry bought a pet hamster named Tom.
Harry loved it when Tom would climb up his arm and into his shirt sleeve.
Every day before bed, Harry would put Tom into his cage.
Every morning, Harry would take Tom out of his cage and carry him around in his front shirt pocket.
Harry would carry Tom everywhere he went.
Harry's favorite thing to do was to watch Tom run around in his exercise wheel.

edges: One day, Harry woke up to find that Tom was not in his cage.
Harry called his friends John, Rodney, and Bruno to ask if they knew where Tom was.
After looking for Tom for two hours, Bruno found Tom inside an old sock behind Harry's desk.
